description: Triage view of up to 20 mail messages at once, as text with the bulk junk removed: invisible padding, image placeholders and quoted reply history (forwards keep theirs). Links are kept: Safe Links, Proofpoint and Google redirects are unwrapped to the real address and tracking parameters (utm_* and similar) dropped; only an address still over 300 characters (a tracking redirect) is shortened to ⟦link: domain⟧. Everything else (signatures, footers, whitespace) is left as the message has it; line endings become \n and ⟦ ⟧ in the body itself appear as [ ]. Use get-mail-message for the raw body or the quoted thread. Give messageIds (up to 20), or folderId with optional top and filter or search for the newest messages in a folder. Each message is cut to maxChars characters (default 3,000; marked truncated: true): pass a larger maxChars, up to 300,000, for the whole of a long message; a body over 300,000 characters is cleaned only that far. If the whole result would exceed the server limit (MS365_MCP_READ_MAIL_TEXT_MAX_CHARS, default 80000) the call fails, listing the largest messages, instead of returning part of it. Returns [{ id, from, to, cc, subject, received, hasAttachments, text, chars, truncated }].

filter.description: With folderId: OData $filter, e.g. receivedDateTime ge 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z or from/emailAddress/address eq 'a@example.com'.

folderId.description: Folder to read from: a well-known name (inbox, sentitems, drafts, archive, deleteditems, junkemail) or a folder id.

maxChars.description: Cut each message text to this many characters (marked truncated). Default 3,000; pass up to 300,000 for the whole of a long message (a body over 300,000 characters is cleaned only that far, also marked truncated).

messageIds.description: Ids of the messages to read (max 20). Give messageIds or folderId, not both.

search.description: With folderId: KQL search, e.g. from:paul subject:"quarterly report" (quoting is normalised as for list-mail-messages). Graph cannot combine it with filter.

top.description: With folderId: how many messages, newest first (default and max 20).

name: read-mail-text
